message: <link> belongs in <head>: in the body, a <link> needs itemprop, or a rel of only dns-prefetch, modulepreload, pingback, preconnect, prefetch, preload, or stylesheet; here its parent is <body>.
<meta> belongs in <head>; here its parent is <body>.
<title> belongs in <head>; here its parent is <body>.
<style> must be in <head>, or be the first child of its parent; here its parent is <div>.
